Reads one JSON request per stdin line and writes one JSON response per line.

enabled compressors, and answers packet events with either an MPLS swapped
one-label stack or the uncompressed IP fallback, including TTL drops.

Planning reduces to a capacitated selection problem: every selected flow claims
one entry at each node of its path.  Non-binding nodes (where the candidate
count already fits the free capacity) are dropped, the remaining flows are
split into independent components over shared binding nodes, and each component
is solved exactly by a branch-and-bound over flow groups that share a binding
signature, using a per-node upper bound and memoised states.  Among
maximum-benefit sets the fewest flows are selected.
"""'''
